what: A defect in running code — behavior that contradicts its intention, charter, or ruling.
why: A bug's falsifier is built in (the wrong behavior IS the falsifier), so the design stage is optional and the pipeline is shorter. Distinct from code-seam (a deliberate change at a seam) — a bug is a correction whose aim is already stated by the thing it contradicts.

v1.why: Shorter than code-seam because THINKME is also skippable — a bug with a clear fix needs no design step. A complex bug that needs design investigation keeps THINKME. TICKETME remains skippable (same as code-seam: a leaf fix goes straight to BUILDME). WATCHME is free (a bug fix can carry a regression watch, but never required).

prove_gate: proof gate — the tester runs the node's proof and emits a VALIDATION; the proof must exercise the corrected behavior and would have failed against the bug.
extra_gates: durability gate — same as code-seam (git commit + push).
kicks_back_on: red proof (the fix doesn't actually fix the behavior) → routes back to build/design.
provenance: first bug class, defined 2026-09-03. Discovered as demanded: bugs were filed as kind=bug with no node-class, running on code-seam's pipeline with stages they didn't need.
